title: Design: image-case format, fixtures and graders
goal: One page fixes how a case carries an image and how each kind is graded
acceptance: Owner decision 2026-11-26 in chat (relayed by the coordinator): "undo the F-143 dependency, park F-142 with its possible uses, and open the Gauntlet pack record"; Italian is required (the owner uses NERV in Italian).

docs/decisions/vision-pack.md covers: the case's image field (a path under examples/vision-v1/images/ plus its sha256, sent to a local model that accepts images), the answer kinds (exact, json-match from F-032, OCR text with tolerance, yes/no checklist), the Italian and English question forms and the fixture-hash identity (image bytes plus prompt)

Fixtures: drawn by code (shapes, colours, counts, rendered text, a simple chart) or openly licensed with the licence, author and URL recorded beside the image; never an image generated by Qwen or another model
Candidate model: gemma4:12b on Ollama (local, accepts images); real model calls only on an explicit run request
Links nerv:F-142 (which waits on this pack) and coordinator:F-016's shared-asset rule: gauntlet owns general packs, a consumer keeps its own cases
privacy: Neutral invented data only; fixture images are drawn by code or openly licensed (licence recorded), never generated by a model; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed. Not a measurement.
